title: Turkey History Tracker Update — May 9, 2026
summary: Turkey's political crisis deepened in May 2026 as the mass corruption trial of Istanbul Mayor İmamoğlu and 412 co-defendants continued, with Turkish police detaining 29 more municipality associates. Istanbul's May Day protests saw 570+ arrests as police blocked Taksim Square, reflecting ongoing civil tensions. The PKK peace process — initiated by Öcalan's February 2025 call for disarmament — remained frozen, with senior PKK figures urging Turkey to remove 'obstacles' to progress. Economic data shows inflation falling to 32.37% (April 2026) from its 2022 peak of 85.5%, while the lira depreciated further to ~45.4 per USD. Turkey is preparing to host the July 2026 NATO Summit in Ankara. Erdoğan met Saudi FM Faisal bin Farhan and engaged in diplomatic contacts with Russia on Iran de-escalation.
